Dear Alex,

Certainly, we can extend your booking from 09 July 2026 to 14 July 2026, which will add 5 additional nights to your stay.

The additional cost for the extension will be AED 1,202.83.

Should you wish to proceed with the extension, please let us know, and we will send you a secure payment link to complete the payment and confirm the additional nights.

We look forward to hearing from you.
